cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Federal Bank card offering luxury lifestyle perks, travel privileges, milestone rewards, and concierge support tailored for affluent customers.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy a discount of up to 15% on dining across several restaurants under the FedDelights program.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Explore exclusive dining and order-in offers, choose your preferred restaurant or meal, and apply the offer code or discount at checkout. Complete the payment with your Federal Celesta credit card to enjoy special savings.

benefitRows.name: INOX
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 on INOX movie tickets, once a quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Go to www.inoxmovies.com and select movies/events to be booked.|On payment page, search for the relevent offer, add card details and click on 'Apply Offer'.|Offer will be applied and the payment amount adjusted accordingly.
